lines.zh: 我几乎没有动，只是挪了一点。
lines.en: I barely move; I only shift a little.

lines.zh: 我的根在地上一点点延。
lines.en: My roots creep across the ground.
I grow no taller, only wider.

lines.zh: 我一动，脚下的方块就开始变。
lines.en: When I stir, the blocks beneath me change.

lines.zh: 我拖着自己往前挪半格。
lines.en: I drag myself forward half a block.

lines.zh: 我移动得很慢，可不曾停。
lines.en: I move very slowly and never stop.
My branches point your way.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都不长了。
lines.en: Nothing grows where I have passed.

lines.zh: 我一直在往外铺，一眼看不到头。
lines.en: I spread outward and there is no end in sight.

lines.zh: 我贴在地面，像一团黑色的菌。
lines.en: I lie on the ground like black fungus.

lines.zh: 我朝有光的方向伸出去。
lines.en: I reach out toward the light.

lines.zh: 我每动一次，世界就坏一点。
lines.en: Every time I move, the world worsens.
I stand, doing nothing.

lines.zh: 我的根须在土里慢慢动。
lines.en: My root hairs work slowly in the soil.
I do not chase; I wait for you to come.
My shape looks grown wrong.

lines.zh: 我身上渗出黑色的东西。
lines.en: Something black seeps out of me.

lines.zh: 我在原地，把地一点点吃掉。
lines.en: I stay here, eating the ground bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我的枝干上有字，看不清。
lines.en: There are letters on my trunk, unreadable.
I am still, yet never idle.
Roots don't breathe. Very quiet.
I wait for you to step on my root.
I lean, tilting slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 这周围的方块已经开始坏了。
lines.en: The blocks around me have started to spoil.
I look like a tree, and I am not.
I am widening my reach.
You stand still, and I grow.
I see you, and I do not move.
You think distance keeps you safe.

lines.zh: 你脚下的地已经是我的。
lines.en: The ground under your feet is already mine.
I do not need to catch you.
Your house will fill with me first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝你这个方向歪。
lines.en: I bend slowly in your direction.
Watch me turning the ground black.
I can wait; you cannot.
I lift a branch as if beckoning.
You step back, and I am there too.
The light you carry reaches so little.
I neither shout nor scream, and that is worse.

lines.zh: 你听得见木头裂开的声音吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the wood splitting?

lines.zh: 你迟早会走到我的根上。
lines.en: Sooner or later you will step on my roots.
I am unworried; I never was.
My range has grown another circle.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我已经在你身后长出来了。
lines.en: While you watch, I have already grown behind you.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，因为我不会跑。
lines.en: You cannot escape, because I do not run.

lines.zh: 我不需要眼睛也知道你在哪。
lines.en: I need no eyes to know where you are.

lines.zh: 我掉了一块，很快又长回来。
lines.en: A piece comes off and grows back.

lines.zh: 我的枝条断了，断口发黑。
lines.en: My branch snaps and the break turns black.
You cut me, and I can only give a little.
My shape sags.
That blow pulls my roots back.
I do not cry out; the wood creaks.

lines.zh: 你砍的地方，立刻开始腐。
lines.en: Where you struck, rot begins at once.
My range shrinks one circle.

lines.zh: 我还在这儿，没那么容易。
lines.en: I am still here; it is not that easy.

lines.zh: 断掉的部分落在地上，还在动。
lines.en: The broken part falls and keeps moving.

lines.zh: 你把方块放下，我就收下。
lines.en: Set your blocks down; I will take them.
What you plant, I like better.
That grove, I will have it.
You stand in the light; I go toward the light.

lines.zh: 你的火把烧得越久越好。
lines.en: The longer your torch burns, the better.
I pave over the path you took.
The wood you brought, I have eaten it.
That bit of water belongs to me too.
Your field will grow wrongly.
The closer you come, the stronger I get.
You hit me and the ground gives under you.
My root hooks your foot.
You step and the block crumbles.

lines.zh: 我被碰得掉了一块，很快补回。
lines.en: A piece of me breaks off and quickly returns.

lines.zh: 我们相触，你的护甲变黑了。
lines.en: We touch and your armour darkens.
One push and part of me scatters.

lines.zh: 我贴在你腿上，往上一寸。
lines.en: I press against your leg and creep up an inch.

lines.zh: 撞上时，一股腐烂的味道。
lines.en: At the impact, a smell of rot.

lines.zh: 你退开，地上留了黑色的印。
lines.en: You pull back and leave a black mark.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，却拖得住你。
lines.en: I have no weight, yet I hold you.
I do not breed; I spread.

lines.zh: 我的种子是坏死的部分。
lines.en: My seed is the dead part.
I need no other me.
I am already enough.
There is only one of me in this ground.
These things grow by themselves.
That question has no meaning.
I do not answer; I only grow.
I bend a branch.
One more night and you will understand.

lines.zh: 我把东西围起来，慢慢收下。
lines.en: I close around it and take it slowly.
Your item is turning black.
I curl a root around it.
If I cannot carry it, I cover it.
This is good; it can be eaten.
I drag it into the soil.

lines.zh: 我拾起它，它就不发光了。
lines.en: I pick it up and it stops glowing.
Whatever lies on the ground is fertilizer.
I slowly wrap it into a lump.

lines.zh: 你回头找，它已经不在了。
lines.en: You look back, and it is gone.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，就在那个位置。
lines.en: I have fixed your position.
The world begins to change under your feet.
I have chosen your patch of ground.
You are standing in my range.
I grow in your direction.
I will take this position.
I send a root your way.
Your house is next.
I need not chase; you will stay put.

lines.zh: 目标就是还站着的那块地。
lines.en: The target is the patch still standing.
Once locked, the ground begins to change.

lines.zh: 你身上有生命，我最喜欢。
lines.en: You carry life, and I like that best.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把范围朝你推。
lines.en: I push my range slowly toward you.
You have appeared at my edge.

lines.zh: 我不需要动就能碰到你。
lines.en: I can reach you without moving.

lines.zh: 这片地，从头到尾都会是我的。
lines.en: This ground will be mine, end to end.
I push a root forward an inch.
You take a step, I spread a block.
My roots spread inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你听到木头断裂，那就是我。
lines.en: That cracking wood is me.

lines.zh: 你的退路上，已经有我了。
lines.en: I am already on your retreat.

lines.zh: 我把四周一点点围起来。
lines.en: I close in on all sides a little at a time.

lines.zh: 你站在没坏的地方，很快就不算了。
lines.en: You stand on unspoiled ground, and soon it will not be.
My range is slowly widening.

lines.zh: 你回头，地面已经变了颜色。
lines.en: You look back and the ground has changed colour.

lines.zh: 我不急切，我只需要时间。
lines.en: I am not hasty; I only need time.

lines.zh: 你的脚步让我知道你在哪。
lines.en: Your steps tell me where you are.
I reach a root hair under your feet.

lines.zh: 你不必回头，我会到你面前。
lines.en: No need to look back; I will arrive in front.
This ground is half spoiled already.
I wait for you to run out of room.

lines.zh: 你的东西在被我的根缠住。
lines.en: Your things are being wound in my roots.
I keep tightening, slowly.
Your torch does not light it all.

lines.zh: 你把地挖开，我还是会长。
lines.en: Dig the ground up and I still grow.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔着这一小片。
lines.en: Only this small patch lies between us.

lines.zh: 我的根在你脚踝上收紧。
lines.en: My root tightens on your ankle.

lines.zh: 一根枝条从后面抽到你的背。
lines.en: A branch whips your back.
I use no force; I simply coil around.

lines.zh: 你被拖到地上，坐进了土里。
lines.en: You are pulled down into the soil.
My twig drives through your sleeve.

lines.zh: 这一下带着腐朽的味道。
lines.en: That blow smells of decay.

lines.zh: 我拍下去，动作很慢却很重。
lines.en: I strike slowly and heavily.
The ground sinks a block under your feet.
I cinch around the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 你被推了一下，方向是土里。
lines.en: One push, and it is into the soil.

lines.zh: 我打到的地方，方块会变。
lines.en: Where I strike, blocks change.

lines.zh: 你甩不掉我，我扒得很紧。
lines.en: You cannot shake me; I grip tightly.
I am in no hurry; this is only the start.
A black mark just appeared on you.

lines.zh: 我抽你一记，声音像折断的枝。
lines.en: I lash you once, a sound like a breaking branch.

lines.zh: 我的根从地下顶起你的脚。
lines.en: My root pushes up under your foot.

lines.zh: 地上的方块先坏了一块。
lines.en: First, one block on the ground rots.
I grow up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 你先闻到一股腐烂的味。
lines.en: You smell rot before anything else.

lines.zh: 墙根多了一团黑色的东西。
lines.en: A black mass appears at the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我出现得很慢，你未必注意。
lines.en: I appear slowly; you may not notice.
At first I am only a single twig.
The ground nearby begins to change colour.
Cracks crawl over from your side.
I squeeze up among the tree roots.

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，只有木头响。
lines.en: I have no footsteps, only creaking wood.
The ground behind you is moving.
I rise slowly in the corner.
The moment I appear, the grass dies.
There is a smell of rust in the air.

lines.zh: 你的第一格方块被染黑了。
lines.en: Your first block has been stained black.
A black branch pushes out of the soil.
I have arrived, slowly.

lines.zh: 我知道你在哪，从一开始就知道。
lines.en: I knew where you were from the start.
This ground is starting to belong to me.

lines.zh: 我从地缝里探出一段枝条。
lines.en: A branch pokes up out of a crack.
Fire scorches my branches first.

lines.zh: 我被人从上面砸下，摊了一片。
lines.en: Something falls on me and I flatten out.

lines.zh: 水把我泡软，我长得慢了。
lines.en: Water softens me and my growth slows.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀开，露出下面更黑的东西。
lines.en: The blast tears me open, showing blacker stuff below.
An arrow sticks in me like a thorn.

lines.zh: 法术照到的地方，我退开了。
lines.en: Where the spell touches, I draw back.

lines.zh: 没有东西可吃，我也在枯。
lines.en: With nothing to feed on, I too wither.
Lightning burns away a whole length of my trunk.

lines.zh: 虚空把我的根一根根抽走。
lines.en: The void pulls my roots out one by one.
